_comment: Run `node scripts/apply-brand.js` to substitute all ${VAR} placeholders
AND to convert any remaining hardcoded literals to their variable equivalents.
For Solana/EVM program addresses, edit programs/program-ids.config.json.
Never commit real secrets — use .env for runtime values.
_BRAND_INFRA_PREFIX_comment: Short uppercase prefix used for Docker container names, network names,
database names, and env var prefixes.
Examples: AXVN → container_name: AXVN-postgres, POSTGRES_DB: AXVN
Set to e.g. MYAPP, AXIOLEDGER, VNKR, etc.
_BRAND_INFRA_PREFIX_LOWER_comment: Lowercase variant used in DB user names (e.g. AXVN_fiat → your_infra_fiat)
_BRAND_DOCKER_REGISTRY_comment: Docker image registry/org prefix. e.g. AXVN → image: AXVN/swift-gateway:latest
_BRAND_NPM_SCOPE_UPPER_comment: Uppercase npm scope used in pnpm --filter @AXVN/pkg. e.g. AXVN, MYAPP
_BRAND_TOKEN_SYMBOL_UPPER_comment: Uppercase token symbol (same as BRAND_TOKEN_SYMBOL by default)
_BRAND_SWIFT_BRIDGE_CONTRACT_comment: Solidity contract name for SWIFT bridge. e.g. AXVNSwiftBridge → BrandSwiftBridge
_BRAND_SDK_SWIFT_CORE_comment: Name of the combined SWIFT SDK package. e.g. @wikialisa/swift-core
